business_meaning: Surrogate key for the savings account dimension
documented_rules: Used as the surrogate key for the dimension (historical SCD2 handling).
inferred_rules: Must be unique per row; not null; used to join to fact tables.

business_meaning: Bank account number assigned to the customer
inferred_rules: Format is bank-specific; should be unique per active account; cannot be null for current rows.

business_meaning: Identifier for the customer who owns the account
inferred_rules: Must reference a customer identifier in source systems; cannot be null for active accounts.

business_meaning: Code of the savings product/plan for the account
inferred_rules: Must be a valid product code from the product master; cannot be null for active accounts.
If AccountStatus = 'CLOSED' then AccountCloseDate must not be null; 'OPEN' implies AccountCloseDate is null; only allowed values as listed.
Should be a 3-character ISO currency code; not null for active accounts.
AccountOpenDate <= AccountCloseDate when AccountCloseDate is present; AccountOpenDate <= ValidTo; cannot be in the future for historical rows.

business_meaning: Maturity date for the account if applicable
inferred_rules: If present, AccountMaturityDate >= AccountOpenDate; may be null for non-term accounts.
If present, AccountCloseDate >= AccountOpenDate; if AccountStatus = 'CLOSED' then must not be null.

business_meaning: Start datetime for this row's validity period (SCD2)
documented_rules: Used as the start of the validity period for SCD2 historical rows.
inferred_rules: Row validity ranges must not overlap for the same business key; ValidFrom < ValidTo for closed periods; ValidFrom is not null.

business_meaning: End datetime for this row's validity period (SCD2)
documented_rules: Used as the end of the validity period for SCD2 historical rows.
inferred_rules: ValidTo > ValidFrom; current row may use a far-future sentinel or a null/maximum value to denote open-ended validity.

business_meaning: Flag indicating whether this row is the current version for the business key
documented_rules: Used to indicate current row in SCD2 handling.
inferred_rules: Exactly one current row (IsCurrent = 1) is expected per business key; when IsCurrent = 1 ValidTo should be open-ended; IsCurrent must be 0 or 1.
